runs.name: channel-sync
runs.about: Fetch new videos: one channel (SyncVideosForChannelJob), or every channel due (SyncAllChannelVideosJob, the 05:00 run)

args.channel: a channel's YouTube id; left out, every active, reviewed channel not synced in a day

runs.name: place-new-videos
runs.about: Place videos that have no occasion yet (PlaceNewVideosJob, the quarter-hourly pass)

args.full: true for the whole walk the 03:10 run does, healing credits added after placement

args.mode: recent (videos changed in the last 30 minutes, the default), full (the whole video index) or listings (the listings index)

runs.name: refresh-couples
runs.about: Recompute couples from co-appearances and prune unsupported ones (RefreshCouplesJob, the 06:00 run)

runs.name: harvest-descriptions
runs.about: Read songs and dancers out of video descriptions (HarvestDescriptionsJob, the 07:15 run)

runs.name: harvest-panels
runs.about: Read the music panels YouTube gave at import (HarvestStoredPanelsJob, the 07:30 run)

runs.name: audio-sweep
runs.about: Match fingerprinted videos that have no audio match yet (AudioMatchSweepJob, the 06:45 run)

runs.name: fingerprint
runs.about: Download one video's audio and fingerprint it (FingerprintVideoJob)

args.force: true to fingerprint again when it already has one

runs.name: availability-check
runs.about: Ask YouTube whether the least recently checked videos are still up, and hide the gone ones (CheckVideoAvailabilityJob, the 02:00 run)

args.batch: how many videos, 1 to 1000 (100 by default)

rebuilds.cost: builds an occasion for every video without one, walking every video 1,000 at a time
files each dated event occasion under an edition per year, walking every one
credits who was there once per occasion, walking every occasion's video credits 5,000 at a time, as the 03:10 run does
decides what kind of view each upload is, walking every placed video 5,000 at a time
builds a dance for each performance, walking every performance occasion 2,000 at a time
compares every occasion's videos and merges the ones that turn out to be one night
pairs who danced with whom, walking every occasion with two or more credits 2,000 at a time
recounts what every dancer, orchestra and event has earned, over the whole catalogue
recomputes every partnership from every pairing in one query, then prunes the stale ones
fills the songs a dance's video learned after the dance was built, walking every dance without music
corrects dance forms an occasion was built before its label landed, walking every occasion
draws the arrows a corrected gender has since earned, walking every pairing with an unknown role

summary: 10 jobs to run and 12 rebuild steps.
breadcrumbs: tt admin job run reindex --arg mode=recent --dry-run
